desc: Ultratech Cement's Kotputli plant is one of the largest integrated cement plants in India, located in the Jaipur district of Rajasthan. It has a production capacity of over 6 million metric tons per year. The plant features advanced dry-process manufacturing technology and is equipped with waste heat recovery systems for energy efficiency. It produces a range of cement products including Ordinary Portland Cement and Portland Pozzolana Cement. The plant serves the construction markets of northern and central India and is part of the Aditya Birla Group.
fact: It is one of the largest integrated cement plants in India at 6 million MT/year · It features waste heat recovery systems for energy efficiency · It is part of Ultratech Cement, Aditya Birla Group · It serves northern and central Indian construction markets

desc: ACC Cement Barmana plant is located in the Bilaspur district of Himachal Pradesh. Established in 1962, it is one of the oldest cement plants in northern India with a capacity of over 2 million metric tons per year. The plant is situated in the Himalayan foothills and has access to high-quality limestone deposits from the nearby Arki hills. It produces blended and specialized cement for infrastructure projects. The plant has undergone several modernization upgrades including a new 1.5 million MT clinkerisation line commissioned in 2023. ACC is part of the Adani Group and the Holcim global network.
fact: It was established in 1962, one of the oldest cement plants in northern India · It accesses high-quality limestone from the Arki hills · It was modernized in 2023 with a new clinkerisation line · ACC is part of the Adani Group and Holcim global network

desc: Ambuja Cement's Ambujanagar plant is the company's flagship facility located in the Amreli district of Gujarat. Established in 1986, the plant has a production capacity of over 4 million metric tons per year. It is strategically located near the Gulf of Khambhat for access to limestone and proximity to ports for distribution. The plant features captive power generation using waste heat recovery and solar energy. It is known for its sustainability initiatives including water conservation and green belt development. Ambuja is part of the Adani Group.
fact: Ambujanagar is Ambuja's flagship plant, established in 1986 · It has a capacity of over 4 million MT/year in Amreli, Gujarat · It features waste heat recovery and solar captive power · Ambuja is part of the Adani Group

desc: UltraTech Cement's Adityapur plant is a major grinding unit located in the Seraikela-Kharsawan district of Jharkhand. Established in 2001, it has a capacity of over 2 million metric tons per year. The plant produces Ordinary Portland Cement and Portland Slag Cement using clinker sourced from integrated plants. It serves the construction markets of eastern India including Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Odisha. The plant, part of the Aditya Birla Group, features automated packing and loading systems and operates with a focus on energy efficiency and reduced carbon footprint.
fact: It is a major grinding unit in eastern India established in 2001 · It produces OPC and PSC cement for eastern markets · It serves Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Odisha · It is part of UltraTech Cement, Aditya Birla Group

desc: Shree Cement's Ras plant is located in the Pali district of Rajasthan and is one of the company's most efficient and modern facilities. With a capacity of over 6 million metric tons per year, it is among the largest single-location cement plants in India. The plant features advanced technology including vertical roller mills and pre-heater cyclones for energy efficiency. It is known for its high operational efficiency, low power consumption, and strong sustainability practices including extensive use of renewable energy and waste heat recovery. Shree Cement is one of India's largest cement manufacturers by capacity.
fact: Ras is among the largest single-location cement plants in India at 6 million MT/year · It features advanced vertical roller mills for energy efficiency · It is known for high operational efficiency and low power consumption · Shree Cement is one of India's largest cement manufacturers

desc: JK Cement's Nimbahera plant is a major grey and white cement manufacturing facility in the Chittorgarh district of Rajasthan. Established in 1975, it was the first cement plant in India to produce white cement. The plant has a grey cement capacity of over 4 million MT and a white cement capacity of over 500,000 MT per year. It is one of the largest white cement manufacturers in India and a leading player globally. The plant is known for its specialized cement products for architectural and decorative applications. JK Cement is part of the JK Organisation.
fact: It was the first cement plant in India to produce white cement, established in 1975 · It is one of the largest white cement manufacturers in India and globally · It has a combined capacity of over 4.5 million MT/year in grey and white cement · JK Cement is part of the JK Organisation
